# Data reading

Read spatial experiment list of all samples and then the csv of the cell_indices

```{r}
spe_list <- readRDS(paste0(Rd_path, "spe_list_nuclei_ann"))
```

```{r}
meta_df <- read_csv("/mnt/europa/valerio/data/data_tables/nuclei_indices_after_GFP_poly_filter.csv")
# a list of columns to transfer in the spe_list, named as the samples
meta_list <- split(meta_df, meta_df$sample_key) |> 
  map(function(df) {
    select(df, -sample_key)
  })

# Check the result
head(meta_list[[1]])


```

```{r}
summary_table <- map_dfr(meta_list, function(df) {
  
  # 1. Calculate GFP Summary
  # Handle cases where GFP might be all FALSE (logical) vs Numeric
  if (is.numeric(df$GFP_value)) {
    gfp_mean <- mean(df$GFP_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    gfp_max  <- max(df$GFP_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    gfp_min  <- min(df$GFP_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    gfp_sd  <- BiocGenerics::sd(df$GFP_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    # If it's boolean/logical (e.g. the "False" fallback), mean gives % of Trues
    gfp_mean <- mean(as.numeric(df$GFP_value), na.rm = TRUE) 
    gfp_max  <- NA # Not relevant for boolean
    gfp_min  <- NA # Not relevant for boolean
  }

  # 2. Return a single row tibble for this sample
  tibble(
    n_nuclei = length(df$cell_id),
    
    # treatment info
    n_in_treatment = sum(df$in_treatment, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_in_treatment = mean(df$in_treatment, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    
    # GFP info
    gfp_mean_val = gfp_mean,
    gfp_max_val = gfp_max,
    gfp_min_val = gfp_min,
    gfp_st_dev = gfp_sd,
  )
}, .id = "sample_key") # This adds the sample name as the first column

# View the results
print(summary_table, n = 50)
```

# Adding the new informations

Check and verify that the names orders are the same for the 2 lists
```{r}
common_samples <- intersect(names(spe_list), names(meta_list))

# 2. REORDER both lists to match that specific order
# This ensures index 1 in spe_list is the same sample as index 1 in meta_list
spe_list <- spe_list[common_samples]
meta_list <- meta_list[common_samples]
```


```{r}
# 2. Update the SPE objects
updated_spe_list <- map2(spe_list, meta_list, function(spe, meta_df) {
  
  # A. Find the indices of SPE cells inside the metadata table
  # match(x, table) returns the index of the first match, or NA if not found
  match_idx <- match(colnames(spe), meta_df$cell_id)
  
  # B. Create 'to_discard'
  # If match_idx is NA, it means the cell is NOT in your filtered list
  colData(spe)$to_discard <- is.na(match_idx)
  
  # C. Transfer 'in_treatment'
  # We map the values using the indices
  val_treat <- meta_df$in_treatment[match_idx]
  # Fill NAs with FALSE
  val_treat[is.na(val_treat)] <- FALSE
  colData(spe)$in_treatment <- val_treat
  
  # D. Transfer 'GFP_value'
  val_gfp <- meta_df$GFP_value[match_idx]
  
  # Check type to decide fill value
  if (is.numeric(val_gfp)) {
    val_gfp[is.na(val_gfp)] <- 0
  } else {
    # Logical or Character -> fallback to FALSE
    val_gfp[is.na(val_gfp)] <- FALSE
  }
  colData(spe)$GFP_value <- val_gfp
  
  return(spe)
})

# 3. Verify
# Check one sample to see if columns were added
head(colData(updated_spe_list[[1]]))
```


```{r}
spe_summary <- map_dfr(updated_spe_list, function(spe) {
  
  # Extract colData as a data frame
  cd <- colData(spe) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  # Filter only the cells we matched (to compare apples-to-apples with meta_list)
  valid_nuclei <- cd %>% filter(to_discard == FALSE)
  
  # Calculate stats
  if (is.numeric(valid_nuclei$GFP_value)) {
    gfp_mean <- mean(valid_nuclei$GFP_value, na.rm = TRUE)
    gfp_max  <- max(valid_nuclei$GFP_value, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    gfp_mean <- mean(as.numeric(valid_nuclei$GFP_value), na.rm = TRUE)
    gfp_max  <- NA
  }

  tibble(
    n_matched = nrow(valid_nuclei), # Should match n_cells in meta summary
    n_total_spe = nrow(cd),        # Total cells in the SPE object
    n_in_treat = sum(valid_nuclei$in_treatment, na.rm = TRUE),
    gfp_mean = gfp_mean
  )
}, .id = "sample_key")

# 2. Join with your previous meta_list summary (The "Expected" data)
# Assuming 'summary_table' is the variable from your previous step
comparison <- spe_summary %>%
  left_join(summary_table, by = "sample_key", suffix = c("_spe", "_meta")) %>%
  mutate(
    # check if counts match
    MATCH_COUNTS = n_matched == n_nuclei,
    # check if GFP means match (allow tiny floating point differences)
    MATCH_GFP = abs(gfp_mean - gfp_mean_val) < 1e-9
  )

# 3. View the mismatches (if any)
print(comparison %>% select(sample_key, MATCH_COUNTS, MATCH_GFP, n_matched, n_nuclei))

# 4. Check if EVERYTHING is perfect
if(all(comparison$MATCH_COUNTS) & all(comparison$MATCH_GFP)) {
  message("✅ INTEGRATION SUCCESSFUL: All data transferred correctly.")
} else {
  message("❌ WARNING: Mismatches detected!")
  print(comparison %>% filter(!MATCH_COUNTS | !MATCH_GFP))
}
spe_summary
```
